084/**
085 * The RowsModel is associated with a {@link javax.sql.RowSet}.
086 * Using {@link NavigateState} and {@link RowsAction} it encapsulates RowSet
087 * traversal and their associated {@link javax.swing.Action}s which can be
088 * plugged into UI components; it broadcasts RowSet events.<p>
089 * {@link RowsModelEvent}s are broadcast when the model's RowSet is changed
090 * and when the current RowSet notifies of eventsNextQ. RowSet eventsNextQ are coalesced
091 * when they occur in operations which are delineated by
092 <ul>
093 * <li> {@link #startRowsEvent }
094 * <li> {@link #finishRowsEvent }
095 * </ul>
096 Other/stray RowSet eventsNextQ are sent individually as soon as they are received.
097 */
098//
099// NOTE: The RowSet must be "executable".
100//       Execution happens in NavigateState::setupRowSet() via RowsModel.
101//       Should RowsModel try to execute if no command?
102//       Handle an "empty"/"null"/non-executable RowSet?
103//       Is there a way to tell if current command has been executed?
104//
105public final class RowsModel {
106  static {
107    LookupDefaults.init();
108  }

154  /**
155   * Find {@link DbOps} for the specified RowSet.
156   * Looks for {@link DbOpsCreator} to create it; if not found
157   * or its {@code create(rowSet)} method returns null,
158   * then return {@code new DbOps() {}} which does nothing.
159   *
160   * @param rs
161   * @param rowsModel where the RowSet is going, null if new RowsModel
162   * @return DbOps to use with this RowSet and RowsModel
163   */
164  public static DbOps findDbOps(RowSet rs, RowsModel rowsModel) {
165    DbOps dbOps = null;
166    // creator may check by DB/TBL/whatever
167    DbOpsCreator creator = CentralLookup.defLookup(DbOpsCreator.class);
168    if (creator != null)
169      dbOps = creator.create(rs, rowsModel);
170
171    if (dbOps == null) {
172      dbOps = new DbOps() {};
173    } // no-op
174    return dbOps;
175  }

203  /**
204   * Create one associated with the given RowSet.
205   * @param rs
206   */
207  // TODO: handle null RowSet; important, consider empty DataNavigator, build UI first.
208  private RowsModel(RowSet rs, DbOps dbOps) {
209    Objects.requireNonNull(dbOps);
210    // TODO: get rid of junit test after tests are fully RowsModel ported.
211    if (!SsUtils.isJunit() && rs != null && !verifyExecuted(rs))
212      logger.log(Level.ERROR, "RowSet not executed", new Exception());
213    logger.log(Level.INFO, () -> sf("new RowsModel %s for %s", objectID(this), objectID(rs)));
214
215    activeRowModels.putIfAbsent(this, true);
216
217    this.rowsActions = new RowsActions(this);
218
219    setNavState(rs, dbOps);
220
221    rowSetListener = new SimpleRowSetListener();
222    rowSetListener.registerTo(rs);
223  }

225  /**
226   * Get and set NavigationState. Two step process because when navState hooks into
227   * the RowSet, it uses the RowsModel.
228   *
229   * <br>TODO: clean up the RowsModel/NavState initialization.
230   *
231   * @param rs
232   * @param dbOps
233   */
234  private void setNavState(RowSet rs, DbOps dbOps) {
235    Objects.requireNonNull(dbOps);
236    if (rs == null) {
237      navState = null;
238      rowsActions.disableAllActions();
239      return;
240    }
241    navState = NavigateState.getOrCreate(rs);
242    navState.setDbOps(dbOps);
243
244    if (navState.getRowSet() == null)
245      navState.setupRowSet(rs);
246  }
247
248  // TODO: verifyExecuted HACK, remove this and require executed row set
249  /**
250   * Check if RowSet is executed. If not executed, then execute it.
251   * @param rs
252   * @return true if was executed
253   * @throws SQLException
254   */
255  static boolean verifyExecuted(RowSet rs) {
256    String msg;
257    try {
258      boolean ok = rs.getMetaData() != null ? rs.getMetaData().getColumnCount() > 0
259                                            : false; // CachedRowSet
260      if (ok)
261        return true;
262      msg = "no exception";
263    } catch (SQLException ex) {
264      msg = ex.getMessage();
265    }
266    String fMsg = msg;
267    try {
268      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> sf("%s. Will execute query", fMsg));
269      // TODO: take out the callExecute error recovery, propogate the exception
270      rs.execute();
271    } catch (SQLException ex1) {
272      logger.log(Level.ERROR, "execute() SQL Exception", ex1);
273    }
274    return false;
275  }

277  /**
278   * Change the RowSet associated with this model; keep the current DbOps.
279   * <p>
280   * <em>Be careful</em> using this method. You must be certain that the
281   * current DbOps is compatible with the new RowSet.
282   *
283   * @param rs new RowSet for this model
284   */
285  public void setRowSet(RowSet rs) {
286    setRowSet(rs, getDbOps());
287  }

289  /**
290   * Change the RowSet associated with this model.
291   * If _dbOps is null, find the default navigator with
292   * {@link #findDbOps(javax.sql.RowSet, dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel) }.
293   * @param rs new RowSet for this model
294   * @param _dbOps
295   * @return false if abort and rowSet not set/changed
296   */
297  // TODO: need programatic disable dialog if discarding uncommited changes? quiet flag.
298  public boolean setRowSet(RowSet rs, DbOps _dbOps) {
299    DbOps dbOps = _dbOps == null ? findDbOps(rs, this) : _dbOps;
300    logger.log(Level.INFO,
301               () -> sf("RowsModel %s change rowSet from %s to %s", objectID(this),
302                        objectID(getRowSet()), objectID(rs)));
303
304    if (isDirty()) {
305      //throw new IllegalStateException("oldRS dirty"); ???
306      logger.log(INFO, "oldRS dirty");
307      // TODO: What if row set is also in a different rowsmodel?
308      //           Then don't want dialog?
309      //       Need a way to programatically disable dialog? quiet flag.
310      //       Or caller/app should check?
311      // parent dialog with enclosing Window. TODO: allow custom find parent
312      Component parent = null;
313      if (!bindings.isEmpty()) {
314        parent = (Component) bindings.keySet().iterator().next();
315        Window win = SwingUtilities.getWindowAncestor(parent);
316        parent = win != null ? win : parent;
317      }
318      int response = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(parent,
319          sf("Setting new RowSet discards\nuncommitted modifications\nto table \"%s\"",
320             SsUtils.tableName(getRowSet())),
321          null, JOptionPane.OK_CANCEL_OPTION);
322      // TODO: Note the rowSet's undo/redo still has the modifications.
323      //       Really discard?
324      if (response != JOptionPane.OK_OPTION)
325        return false;
326    }
327
328    if (rs != null) {
329      verifyExecuted(rs);
330
331      // TODO: May need a setRowSet variant that allows replacing dirty rowSet.
332      NavigateState newNS = NavigateState.get(rs);
333      if (newNS != null && newNS.undoRow.isDirty())
334        //throw new IllegalStateException("newRS dirty"); ???
335        logger.log(INFO, "newRS dirty");
336
337      // Check for component binding compatibility here
338      // to avoid exception buried in event handler.
339      for (Map.Entry<SsComponent, String> entry : bindings.entrySet()) {
340        SsComponent comp = entry.getKey();
341        if (!comp.isFullyBound())
342          continue;
343
344        // verify same column type and nullable.
345        String colName = entry.getValue();
346        JDBCType oldType = comp.getColumnJDBCType();
347        JDBCType newType = JDBCType.NULL;
348        try {
349          newType = RowSetOps.getJDBCColumnType(rs, colName);
350        } catch (SQLException ex) {
351          logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
352        }
353        if (newType != oldType)
354          throw new IllegalArgumentException(JDBCTypeMismatch(oldType, newType));
355        boolean oldVal = comp.getAllowNull();
356        boolean newVal = RowSetOps.isNullable(rs, colName).get();
357        if (oldVal != newVal)
358          throw new IllegalArgumentException(NullabilityMismatch(oldVal, newVal));
359      }
360    }
361
362    RowSet oldRowSet = getRowSet();
363    rowSetListener.unregisterFrom(oldRowSet);
364    setNavState(rs, dbOps);
365
366    rowSetListener.registerTo(rs);
367    enq.postNewRowSetEvent(this, oldRowSet);
368    return true;
369  }

376  /**
377   * Establish bindings.
378   * @param binds
379   */
380  public void bind(Map<SsComponent, String> binds) {
381    for (Map.Entry<SsComponent, String> binding : binds.entrySet()) {
382      bind(binding.getKey(), binding.getValue());
383    }
384  }
385
386  private String bindPairName(SsComponent comp, String columnName) {
387    return sf("<%s,%s>", objectID(comp), columnName);
388  }
389
390  /**
391   *
392   * @param comp
393   * @param columnName
394   */
395  // TODO: deprecate in favor of bind(Map)
396  @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
397  public void bind(SsComponent comp, String columnName) {
398    // Check that there's no existing binding for comp or columnName.
399    for (Map.Entry<SsComponent, String> entry : bindings.entrySet()) {
400      if (Objects.equals(comp, entry.getKey())) {
401        throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf(
402            "SSComponent of %s already bound in RowsModel %s of %s", bindPairName(comp, columnName),
403            objectID(this), bindPairName(comp, entry.getValue())));
404      }
405      // ColumnName can be bound to multiple components
406      // if (Objects.equals(columnName, entry.getValue())) {
407      //    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
408      //            sf("ColumnName of %s already bound in RowsModel %s of %s",
409      //                    bindPairName(comp, columnName), objectID(this),
410      //                    bindPairName(entry.getKey(), columnName)));
411      // }
412    }
413    bindings.put(comp, columnName);
414    try {
415      comp.bind(this, columnName); // Only allowed from RowsModel
416    } catch (Exception ex) {
417      bindings.remove(comp);
418      throw ex;
419    }
420  }

450  /**
451   * Use rsOp to capture multiple RowSet eventsNextQ into a single event.
452   *
453   * @param operator
454   * @param r code that operates on a RowSet
455   * @throws java.sql.SQLException
456   */
457  // TODO: need javadoc examples.
458  public void rsOp(Object operator, DbSupport.RunnableSQL r) throws SQLException {
459    RowsModel.startRowsEvent(OperatorKind.OTHER, this, operator);
460    try {
461      r.run();
462    } finally {
463      RowsModel.finishRowsEvent(this);
464    }
465  }

564  private int getRow(boolean isSync) {
565    int spin_row = getRowNumberModel().getNumber().intValue();
566    try {
567      int rs_row = getRowSet().getRow();
568      if (spin_row != rs_row) {
569        // TODO: Instruct to use rowsModel.setRow().
570        if (!isSync)
571          logger.log(ERROR, sf("spinner model, %d, out of sync with row set %d", spin_row, rs_row),
572                     new IllegalStateException("getRow sync"));
573        // RESYNC SPINNER
574        setRow(rs_row);
575        int spin_row2 = getRowNumberModel().getNumber().intValue();
576        int rs_row2 = getRowSet().getRow();
577        if (spin_row2 != rs_row || rs_row != rs_row2)
578          throw new IllegalStateException("Spinner failed to sync");
579        spin_row = rs_row;
580      }
581    } catch (SQLException ex) {
582      // TODO: random sql exception
583    }
584    return spin_row;
585  }

799  /**
800   * Put all the navigation actions into the action map.
801   * If the param is null, a new actionMap is constructed and filled
802   * @param actionMap the actionMap to fill; may be null
803   * @return the filled actionMap
804   */
805  public ActionMap fillNavActionMap(ActionMap actionMap) {
806    ActionMap am = actionMap != null ? actionMap : new ActionMap();
807    Arrays.stream(RowsAction.values()).forEach(key -> {
808      if (!key.isVirtual())
809        am.put(key, getAction(key));
810    });
811    return am;
812  }

832  /**
833   * Use a Weak listener. Otherwise remove from rowset easily doesn't happen.
834   * If not weak, this model will not be collected while the
835   * RowSet exists; the rowset's NavigationAction would not be collected.
836   */
837  private abstract class RowSetListenerBase implements RowSetListener {
838    private WeakReference<RowSetListener> refWeakRowSetListener;
839
840    protected void registerTo(RowSet rs) {
841      if (refWeakRowSetListener != null)
842        throw new IllegalStateException("Already using listener");
843      RowSetListener wrsl = WeakListeners.create(RowSetListener.class, this, rs);
844      refWeakRowSetListener = new WeakReference<>(wrsl);
845      if (rs != null)
846        rs.addRowSetListener(wrsl);
847    }
848
849    protected void unregisterFrom(RowSet rs) {
850      if (refWeakRowSetListener != null) {
851        if (rs != null) {
852          RowSetListener wrsl = refWeakRowSetListener.get();
853          rs.removeRowSetListener(wrsl);
854        }
855        refWeakRowSetListener.clear();
856        refWeakRowSetListener = null;
857      }
858    }
859  }
860
861  private final RowSetListenerBase rowSetListener;
862
863  private class SimpleRowSetListener extends RowSetListenerBase {
864    @Override
865    public void rowSetChanged(RowSetEvent event) {
866      addRowSetEvent(RowSetEventType.ROW_SET_CHANGED, (RowSet) event.getSource());
867    }
868
869    @Override
870    public void rowChanged(RowSetEvent event) {
871      addRowSetEvent(RowSetEventType.ROW_CHANGED, (RowSet) event.getSource());
872    }
873
874    @Override
875    public void cursorMoved(RowSetEvent event) {
876      addRowSetEvent(RowSetEventType.CURSOR_MOVED, (RowSet) event.getSource());
877    }
878  };
